subject: Fwd/Recap: Deployment drivers — SSO, KMS/HSM, log retention (Finosys)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia@finosys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + clarifying asks — deployment drivers (SSO, KMS/HSM, retention)

Hi Olivia — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and the few clarifying items that will determine whether Finosys should go Dedicated (reserved capacity) or Private (VPC / on-prem):

Summary (what we heard)
- SSO: Finosys standard is Okta SAML; you require SCIM provisioning for user sync and want IdP-initiated SSO support.
- KMS/HSM: Preferred model is customer-managed keys. Primary preference: AWS KMS with AWS CloudHSM backing (BYOK). If BYOK at the HSM level is mandatory, you will need a deployment that gives you control of the private key material.
- Log retention & audit: regulatory requirement to retain audit logs for 3 years; sensitive access logs may need tamper-evident retention and quarterly exports for compliance.

Pending clarifications (asks from our side)
1) Can you confirm whether BYOK via AWS KMS (with CMK managed in your AWS account and key policies granting Redwood encrypt/decrypt) satisfies your security team, or do you require an HSM appliance in your VPC?
2) Please confirm exact log retention policy: global 3 years for audit logs, or any subset that must be retained longer/immutable?
3) Do you have any must-have network egress restrictions (e.g., no public endpoints, private endpoints only to specific AWS account VPCs)?

Attachments: I attached a short checklist for SSO/KMS/log questions (Finosys_SSO_Requirement.pdf).

What this means for deployment:
- If BYOK via customer-owned AWS KMS (CloudHSM-backed) is acceptable, we can typically deliver Dedicated capacity with KMS integration and strict VPC peering and key policies; that gives predictable throughput and simpler ops.
- If you require customer-controlled HSM devices inside your VPC or on-prem HSM appliances (customer holds key material), we'll need to look at Private (VPC or on-prem) deployment — this has higher setup time and operational coordination.

Next steps / proposed timeline
- Olivia: confirm the BYOK vs. HSM requirement and the exact retention window by end of day Friday.
- Redwood: we'll prepare two short option sheets (Dedicated + BYOK integration path, Private BYOK/HSM path) and a rough timeline + cost delta.

Thanks — happy to jump on a follow-up with security contacts if that helps.

Cheers,
Jonas
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0147

From: Olivia Park <olivia@finosys.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finosys Procurement <procurement@finosys.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + clarifying asks — deployment drivers (SSO, KMS/HSM, retention)

Thanks Jonas — appreciate the clear recap. A few points from our security and procurement teams: 

1) SSO: Okta SAML with SCIM is required. IdP-initiated flows need to be supported; we will provide SAML metadata once we confirm the path.

2) KMS/HSM: Our baseline expectation is customer-managed keys. We prefer AWS KMS with CMKs in our AWS account and CloudHSM as the backing HSM. If Redwood can operate with CMKs where the key material never leaves our account (you get decrypt permissions via key policy or IAM role), that is acceptable.

However, Procurement noted a potential hard requirement: in certain regulated workflows (payment reconciliation), keys must be held in a dedicated HSM appliance that sits inside our VPC (we call this "BYOHSM"). If we need BYOHSM for those workflows, Private deployment or on-prem will be necessary. Please confirm how Redwood supports:
- BYOK (customer CMK in our AWS account)
- BYOHSM (customer-managed HSM appliance / CloudHSM cluster inside VPC)

3) Log retention: Security requires 3 years of audit logs with write-once export snapshots quarterly. A 3-year retention with quarterly signed exports satisfies compliance.

4) Data residency / network: our data must remain in us-west-2; any control plane operations that involve metadata are acceptable in region, but production inference traffic must not egress outside our VPC for Private. For Dedicated, private peering to our VPC is acceptable.

I've attached the security matrix and retention spreadsheet (Finosys_Security_Retention.xlsx). Can you return a short doc that maps: (A) how Redwood supports BYOK, (B) what changes for BYOHSM, and (C) a realistic delta in time to production and cost between Dedicated + BYOK vs Private + BYOHSM?

Olivia Park
Head of Security Operations, Finosys
olivia@finosys.com

Thanks — putting together a concise recommendation and next steps. High level:

Recommendation (short)
- Start with Dedicated + BYOK via customer-owned AWS KMS (CMK in Finosys account) as the primary path. This meets most of their requirements (Okta SCIM/IdP flows, regional peering to us-west-2, 3-year log retention via our export pipeline). Dedicated gets them predictable latency and faster time-to-value.

- If Finosys mandates BYOHSM for any regulated workflow subset, move those workflows to Private (VPC or on-prem) where the HSM lives in their account/VPC. We should propose a hybrid approach in the SOW: core product on Dedicated with regulated workflows on Private if needed.

Implementation notes / delta
- Dedicated + BYOK: estimated 4-6 week integration (security review, KMS policy setup, private peering, 1x architecture workshop). Lower cost premium compared to hosted but much faster than Private.
- Private + BYOHSM: estimated 10-14 week project (HSM procurement/CloudHSM cluster, network design, ops runbook, longer testing window). Higher upfront engineering and recurring ops costs.

Required deliverables for customer conversation
1) Two one-pagers: Dedicated+BYOK (technical map + key policy example), Private+BYOHSM (HSM options + runbook).
2) Architecture workshop slots (Neha to propose).
3) Draft SOW with hybrid option and cost delta.

I'll create the two one-pagers and a short cost delta table by Monday morning and drop them into the HubSpot deal record. Neha — please propose two workshop times next Tue/Wed. Soojin — I'll need your KMS policy snippets and a CloudHSM sizing note by EOD Monday.
